svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Ten steps · two quality gates · one approval checkpoint · intent × rigor × scale. Committing is a rhythm that crosses every step, never a step of its own.
the wave shape locks here, and the run goes quiet
· one checkpoint — not a series of small confirmations
· the user approves the plan, the slices, the locked matrix
· a rigor floor is advice: an override is recorded, never refused
· below this line the run is unattended, within stop-and-wake
WALK-AWAY — UNATTENDED, WITHIN THE STOP-AND-WAKE RULES
Roughly one checkpoint commit per step, and every one of them passes canonical-sdlc-evidence-gate.sh. Not a numbered step — a rhythm the length of the row above.
Update ## SDLC State BEFORE staging: the gate reads the file on disk, never the diff. There is no commit: field to fill in — the SHA lives in git.
scale: task — the whole row, compressed
The ten steps collapse to one line each in a ## Tasks ledger, and
the gate reads current: T<n> instead of a step number. Nothing
is dropped; the artifact is smaller, and the gates still bind.
An epic short-circuits any intent after Step 3: it emits
epic.spec and epic.plan, carves waves, and hands each wave its
own run of this row. Steps 4–9 belong to the waves.
A spike ships no code, so it has no plan file, no worktree, no
gates, no commits. It produces one writeup at
<docs-root>/spikes/<slug>.md, and the decision it bought is it.
THE TRIPLE — THREE INDEPENDENT DIALS, DECLARED AT STEP 0 AND SHOWN BACK TO THE USER BEFORE ANYTHING RUNS
build · bugfix · refactor · tune · spike · incident-response
The deltas are real, not labels: bugfix's Step-4 failing test IS
the repro; refactor's spec is "behavior preserved", and a new
Each tier contains the one before it. audited is the tier that
adds the independent critic at Step 6. Floors advise; they never
refuse — the user's lower value is taken, and recorded.
Scale changes the artifact, not the discipline: a task keeps a
ledger line, a wave the full spec-and-plan pair, an epic only
what outlives its waves. A barred cell is rejected at Step 0.
red = approval checkpoint, and the walk-away boundary it opens
grey = context that shapes the row rather than sitting in it
composed SVG — this file is the source · pinned by tests/cross-gate-agreement.test.sh §V
